_comment: Explicit, reviewed exceptions for audit-licenses.mjs. Each entry needs name, version ('*' for any), license (the SPDX expression that was verified by reading the package's LICENSE) and a reason. Overrides are listed in docs/LICENSES.md. Keep this list empty unless a human reviewed the package.

overrides.name: caniuse-lite
overrides.reason: 2026-10-24, Decision 9. Dev-only: pulled in by autoprefixer and browserslist at build time; not in the production dependency tree and not in dist/ (checked the built bundle). CC-BY-4.0 requires attribution (author, license link, indication of changes) only when the data itself is shared; the compiled app does not include it. If caniuse-lite or browserslist data is ever bundled into the app, add the attribution 'caniuse-lite data by Alexis Deveria and contributors (caniuse.com), CC BY 4.0' to the licenses screen first.

overrides.name: argparse
overrides.reason: 2026-10-24, Decision 9. Dev-only: js-yaml@4.3.2 <- @eslint/eslintrc <- eslint, used by its CLI only; not in the production tree and not in dist/. Python-2.0 (PSF license) is permissive and GPL-compatible: it only requires keeping the copyright notice and license text when redistributing, and the package is never redistributed with the app.

overrides.name: parse-cache-control
overrides.reason: 2026-10-24. Declares no license field (only a legacy 'licenses' URL), but the package LICENSE file is the 3-clause BSD license (Copyright Walmart and contributors). Dev-only: lives in the tests/ QA toolchain (lighthouse), never shipped.
